{"code":""""Check normalized text symmetry."""
import unicodedata

def solve(text):
    """Return whether normalized text reads equally in both directions."""
    if not text:
        return True
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', text).casefold()
    stripped = ''.join(ch for ch in normalized if not ch.isspace())
    return stripped == stripped[::-1]"

"code": """"Count normalized whitespace-delimited words."""
import unicodedata

def solve(text):
    """Return intended casefolded word frequencies."""
    counts = {}
    # Normalize Unicode to decomposed form then casefold for robust case-insensitivity
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', text)
    # Split on any whitespace sequence, not just single space
    words = normalized.split()
    for word in words:
        # Apply casefolding to handle all Unicode case variations
        key = word.casefold()
        if key:  # Omit empty tokens
            counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1
    return counts
